news.title: VIP Spotlight: Hammad Sets Record with 100% Agency Talent Bookings & Top Reviews!
news.content:
Moon Enterprises is proud to recognize our top elite client, Hammad, for achieving an unprecedented milestone across both Division A and Division B management rosters!

Hammad has officially set a new platform record by successfully booking every single model and talent across our active catalog. Beyond his unmatched loyalty and frequent bookings, Hammad has also become our #1 Verified Reviewer, consistently delivering detailed, high-value feedback and image-verified reviews for all hosted events.

Key Highlights:

Total Bookings: 100% Talent Roster Coverage (Division A & Division B).

Community Standing: Ranked #1 Top Reviewer on Moon Enterprises.

VIP Status: Lifetime Priority Protocol & Dedicated Event Assistance.

We extend our ultimate appreciation to Hammad for his continued trust and active participation in making Moon Enterprises the premier talent agency in the region!
